notes:
I found no underwater basket weaving for toddlers in Halton Hills. The basket-weaving classes that came up were all in other places, and none were for toddlers. Here are three real toddler programs from Halton Hills operators. Each is based on the operator's own page.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Parent & Tot to Swimmer 3 lessons, Acton Lion's Indoor Pool",
      "age_fit": "Parent & Tot 1/2/3 is for 4 months to 3 years, with a parent",
      "when": "Acton fall schedule, Saturday October 3 to Thursday December 3, 2026 (the page gives no day or time for the Parent & Tot class)",
      "price": "$86.22 for 9 lessons (30 minute lesson)",
      "source_name": "Town of Halton Hills"
    },
    {
      "name": "Drop-in Family Swim Lessons, Parent & Tot 123, Gellert Community Centre",
      "age_fit": "Beginner swimmers from 4 months to 5 years, parent in the water, 1 adult per child (from the winter 2026 schedule)",
      "when": "Tuesdays or Thursdays from 10:00 a.m.; the program runs September 22 to December 29, 2026",
      "source_name": "Town of Halton Hills"
    },
    {
      "name": "Parent and Tot, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre",
      "age_fit": "18 months - 3.11 yrs, with parent participation, 30 min class",
      "when": "Fall 2026 session, 13 weeks, September 12 to December 18; registration opened July 20 (no day or time on the page)",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    }
  ]
}
```


The Acton fall schedule lists Parent & Tot to Swimmer 3 at $86.22 for 9 lessons of 30 minutes, with daytime lessons and evening and weekend lessons running separately.
 
The town's level guide places ages 4 months to 3 years in Parent & Tot 1, 2 or 3.


For the Gellert drop-in, 
the fall dates are Tuesday or Thursday from 10:00 a.m., and the program runs September 22 to December 29, 2026.
 I couldn't find a price for it. The 10:00–10:30 length and the 4 months to 5 years age range come from the winter 2026 schedule PDF, not the fall page.

For the gymnastics class, 
the fall 2026 session runs September 12 to December 18, and registration opens July 20. The class involves parent participation.
 The page doesn't give a day, time or price for it.
